question:
Select the most appropriate synonym to replace the underlined word in the given sentence.

No __altruistic __act is truly sincere.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"altruistic"** means showing a selfless concern for the well-being of others; unselfish. (निःस्वार्थ)

 
 
• **Example: **Her** altruistic **nature made her volunteer at the local shelter every weekend.
 
 
 
• **"Philanthropic" **refers to seeking to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money to good causes; generous and benevolent. (परोपकारी)
 
 
• **Example: **The billionaire's** philanthropic** efforts have improved the lives of many underprivileged children.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'altruistic' **is **'philanthropic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Phantasmal **(मायावी): Something that is like a phantom or ghost; illusory.

 
 
• **Example:** The phantasmal figure disappeared as quickly as it appeared.
 
 
 
• **Phenomenal **(असाधारण): Very remarkable or extraordinary.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a phenomenal ability to remember even the smallest details.
 
 
 
• **Phonotypical** (ध्वन्यात्मक): Relating to the representation of speech sounds by symbols.
 
 
• **Example:** The phonotypical transcription of the word helps in its correct pronunciation.
